component.name: Sharpr
component.summary: Find, curate and prepare wallpaper-grade images

description.p: Sharpr is a fast, offline app for finding, curating and preparing wallpaper-grade images from a large local collection. Folders are the source of truth, and Sharpr never modifies your original files.

ul.li: Browse real folders in a fast filmstrip and a large viewer.
Find images by describing them in words, with an optional local model, plus format, resolution and aspect filters.
Keep favourites in nested buckets that survive files being moved outside Sharpr.
Compare selections, and find exact, resized and converted copies.
Crop a copy and batch-export lossless or lossy WebP.

description.p: Visual search, buckets that follow moved files, Compare and Survey, Find Copies, crop and batch WebP export, and a reviewed interface with its own compact look.

SQLite library index, tags and collections with tag inheritance, duplicate detection via dHash, resolution-based quality scoring, Resize Copy (JPEG/PNG/WebP/JXL), generic Compare, and presentation mode.
Initial MVP release: three-pane adaptive UI, thumbnail filmstrip, image preview, metadata overlay.
